items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: I had a bass player by the name of Lonnie Mitchell from Texas

ctx.x: Who was in the band there then when you first started, Pete Herman?

Well I had five men. I had Louis Escobedo, at that time I had Bob Doyle on piano, and Charlie Stowe, and I had a bass player by the name of Lonnie Mitchell from Texas, who later was replaced by Johnny Bell. Remember Johnny Bell? You probably heard of him. He played bass. He died some years ago. But a nice little group, five pieces. Then Louis left, Louis Escobedo left, and I got Bill McElhaney.
